problem: In American English the lodging sense is normally plural ('book accommodations', 'hotel accommodations'); singular uncountable 'accommodation' is British.
'capable' can stand alone (a capable manager; She is very capable), so a missing 'of' is not the reason; it fails because tickets cannot have ability.
fix: capable 形容人有能力；門票不會「有能力」

fix: 「退休」義不接受詞；retire the award 不通

problem: 'hire' can be used without an object (We're hiring.), so 'must have an object' is false; it fails because fares cannot hire anyone.
fix: 主詞要是公司或人；票價不會「雇用」人

problem: 'retire our website' is real English (take it out of service), so 'retire takes no object' is false here; it fails on meaning.
